title: lsystem

messages.description: set start step and generate output

methods.description: iterates and outputs a new generation step (from 0 when reset or from the last generated pattern)
open textfile, no symbol opens dialog window
save textfile, no symbol saves to current name
show text window (same as clicking on the object)

body:
An L-system (Lindenmayer system) is a formal grammar used to generate recursive, self-similar fractal patterns. It takes a textfile containing generation rules and a start number of generation steps as arguments.
generates the pattern with the start step number (given as argument or float input)
